provenance.notes: MLX Swift LM 3.32.3; simulator unsupported by upstream.
Real Mac output comparison is recorded separately from simulator runs.

context.conditions: Owner-selected simulator evaluation. Same fictional corpus; one cold suite followed by five warm suites using the same adapter. Each suite rebuilds its derived index. Text requests reuse weights with fresh context. CPU: llama decode/batch threads=4; Cactus CACTUS_NUM_THREADS=4 before first SDK use. OS/Accelerate scheduling may differ. Network isolation not instrumented. Battery/physical heat not measured.
